description_en: Submits a workflow job to process a video
description_zh: 对视频发起点播工作流处理
name: SubmitWorkflowJob

parameters.description_en: The workflow ID. Log on to the [ApsaraVideo VOD console](https://vod.console.aliyun.com). In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Configuration** > **Media Processing** > **Workflows** to view the ID.
parameters.description_zh: 工作流ID。可登录[点播控制台](https://vod.console.aliyun.com)，选择**配置管理** > **媒体处理配置** > **工作流管理**查看ID。

parameters.name: workflow_id

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the video. You can obtain the media ID in one of the following ways:

- Log on to the [ApsaraVideo VOD console](https://vod.console.aliyun.com) and choose **Media Library** > **Audio/Video** to view the media ID of a video uploaded through the console.

- If you call the [CreateUploadVideo](~~55407~~) operation to obtain an upload URL and credentials, the media ID is returned as the value of the VideoId parameter in the response.

- After a video is uploaded, you can call the [SearchMedia](~~86044~~) operation to query the media ID. The media ID is returned as the value of the VideoId parameter in the response.
parameters.description_zh:
媒资ID，即视频ID。可通过以下方式获取：
- 通过控制台上传的视频，可登录[点播控制台](https://vod.console.aliyun.com)，选择**媒资库** > **音/视频**查看视频ID。
- 通过[获取视频上传地址和凭证](~~55407~~)接口获取上传地址和凭证时，视频ID为返回参数VideoId的值。
- 视频上传后，可通过[搜索媒体信息](~~86044~~)接口查询视频ID，为请求后返回参数VideoId的值。
